description: Smart-search filters for the Agreement Expiry tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Not offered: customerRefId, lineStatus, allocationStatus (all dropped by request). Note the view reports lineStatuses/allocationStatuses as joined lists while those params take a single status, so re-adding them needs one option per list element.
